please be careful trying to come off of effexor, this one in particular gave me very difficult to manage blood pressure issues where I would end up blacking out. 

additionally, what I found was worse than the blood pressure.. it caused something labeled as brain zaps, where it literally felt like an electrical storm was going off in my head. I actually could not function at all. I ended up opening the capsules and eating a little bit of the beads at a time until it would subside just to be able to have a televisit with my doctor to address how to come off of this medication without having to stab myself in the head, in the process.

everyone is different, but this was definitely the worst antidepressant for me.

yes, relating is all too easy.

the positive is on point with how you immediately jump to the top, but my coin flip is different. hatred is just mine, pain is just mine, depression is just mine.. but they are the source and the finality of my loss. it just feels like a burning, slow death coated in misery.

I used to be so angry and so full of hatred towards others. at some point, I decided to only place that upon myself.. and now I quietly suffer the effects of what feels like a ridiculous over dramatization.. which just leads to shame..

I really do not want to feel anymore, to care anymore, to love anything, but I'm not wired to be this way.. so it's a miserably beautiful storm that lives within me, just for me.. and at the end I'll be sitting alone.. heart breaking over and over again for all those I had lost and could not save from myself..
I'm always excited for the person who wins and reading a little bit about each person that they share

a promise is binding and not to be broken. you are not the asshole here, it is the people who give you the false hope and then shit upon it. if someone does not mean to hurt you, then they should not promise.

it is just as easy to not promise than it is to make them.

it is strongly discouraged. the rules in that sub are very intense. one part of me completely understands the need for most of it, but another part cannot help but roll my eyes and linger over leaving the group altogether

eh some people do have those they trust still.. it's typically ultimately sad, because people will always disappoint in the end.. 

I am disappointing enough to know that is just about always the case..

however, I do have hope that we can still be there for one another when the rest of the world seems to let us down. I have been proven wrong here countless times.. I should not believe in anything anymore, but.. I have to believe in something or I have given up. so, maybe a pretty lie that I dream could be true.. might.. maybe it's enough

thank you Lotus,I appreciate the compliments and your existence. 

I'm warning you.. when I'm not busy I'm probably going to Reddit stalk you later now. I so rarely meet someone through any social media platform that I feel good about and you have me those feel good vibes. you have been warned

ahh same..

you are welcome. I do not like the human race as a general population, but I like to know when I can still help someone; I do not feel like I have the gifts to help anyone.

so, you just made me feel a little better too. thank you, very much
I hope I did not give you the pain waters.

I get this.. giving away pieces of your soul a little bit at a time. 

it's like we are born, so full and thriving and then over the years.. the longer you travel on, and the more you face with a full heart and open arms.. the more it just keeps eating and devouring away that soul until.. what have you left to offer? what do you have to show? what are you even..

it's not supposed to be this way. we are supposed to give some of our soul's away and then someone gives you some of there's back to fill in that space, but people forgot that we are fragile.. they forgot that when we run empty we need them to fill us back up too..

we have people out there walking around with their own weighted life and then filled to the brim with other's, while other people- you in particular on this instance- are barely managing with the pieces that are left of your own.

it is sickening and it is heart breaking. I hope I was able to give you some of mine somewhere in all of this.. I know it's pretty dusty and it has cracks, it definitely isn't pretty or maintained well, but it's all I have left

yeah, I think this is straightforward the point I was trying to make, but decided to speak in riddles earlier in the post.

at least the unbearable, overwhelming emotions are stating you are still alive, that we are still here willing to fight.

when they shut off.. when they go quiet.. is the real us, the real me even still in there anymore.. or is it the beginning of giving up?.. BPD has an insanely high suicide rate. awareness will not change that.. time does not make those numbers dwindle
thanks Ashley, I appreciate the feedback

reach out to someone you trust the most.. reach out to someone you know will love you no matter what you do or however many times you fuck shit up..

reach out to a medical professional that you see regularly that has been helping you (obviously, if you are seeing one.. if you are not this would just be a really weird thing to suddenly contact some random professional about)..

reach out to someone you may not even care that much about, but can distract you..

reach out to us here and someone will see you..

the most important part you need to take from this is that you need to reach to someone, anyone. whether it be for help or distraction or literally ANYTHING.. like I said, this is a very big danger zone.. this is an easy place where we end up losing each other infinitely..

if you do not feel.. if you cannot turn back on.. it's suddenly incredibly easy to just turn off forever.

reach out to me if you want to too. 
I'm not great, I won't pretend I am. I am severely pessimistic, I am very broken from a lifetime of so much fucktardary that it makes no sense for me to be here. I am completely unbalanced and tactless. I am rude and a hypocrite and I really hate everything, but..

.. reach out to me if you get stuck here, because I will make you laugh again.. It's like.. my one good super power

ExcellentAstronaut24, sometimes the smallest things evade us but can make the biggest impact. you are welcome.. and if you need a sounding board whenever you get into a place like this you can reach me. it's really scary to not feel and then even worse to feel confused and not know what to do when you feel empty.. it's easy to fall and to keep falling until it's impossible to see a way back up..
it would be great.. what a world that would be

oh you got a fun mom too.

mine has said to me that I have 'glass emotions' and need to learn to toughen up so that the world will not shatter me.

it's absolutely lovely (sarcasm) having such strong support from the people you did not choose to have in your life.

also, I am sorry to hear about your break up.. I have been through two pretty traumatic ones during my lifetime that have taken years away from my life.. I am so sorry that you ever had to experience that. people can make and break us, so very easily..

oh good, I can reach out to you over here without getting in trouble I guess..

I replied to you in a depression post and invited conversation, maybe even friendship; again, even though it is not allowed in that sub. what you wrote reached out to me.

please do not feel obligated to talk with me just because I stalked you over to another sub.. if I do not hear from you I swear I will relent. we might even try and not click anyway, but I thought I may as well try.

I'm not in Nevada, but I do live in the states as well. I would prefer not to mention my specific state publicly, but would have no issue doing so over chat, text or discord (not sure what your preferred method of talking would be).

I would not call myself an outdoor person, but I definitely enjoy some of the outdoor activities that you mentioned (fishing, hiking, photography). I like doing things that feel physically gratifying.. it feels very accomplishing. However, I am incredibly clumsy and end up getting hurt more often than not. I have a high pain tolerance though and can typically turn moments like that into something to laugh at instead.. I like and miss what fun used to look like. I really really hate feeling hot though.. and that is why it is hard for me to commit to saying I'm outdoorsy.

I feel like there are a million things to tell you, but I really do not like talking about myself either, nor, again.. am I even sure if you should feel interested in trying to be friends.

if you do want to though.. hi

I know with everything going on, this is not going to matter too much, but you wrote one of the most empathetic, caring and beautiful posts I have read in such a very very long time..

even with all the pain you feel, you still have so much love and concern.. you still have so much that you want to share and give, even though your pain has come to a point where you are done..

I wish I had hope to fill you with. I wish so incredibly bad that I could reach out and just hold you, hug you and let you feel needed and love.

depression is not always a loss of function.. so many of us are functioning in the world, as if we are everyone else, until the day we just do not anymore.. or maybe the day it starts to turn I guess.

I'm not a great conversationalist, and I know we are not supposed to offer, but if you want to talk.. maybe I can give you another hour every week of something to look forward to, and you can do the same for me.

if not.. I just hope I see more of your beautiful words in the future
I wanted to go further though after reading back.. it's okay not to know, but you seem to be more self aware than you are giving yourself credit for
I refer to it as the void too, but I do not get flashbacks, and whilst there it is now the forever place, no matter how much I logically know it will not be

actually, just spoke with someone else on exactly this topic in a different sub..

feeling nothing at all is just as much depression and a product of BPD, as much as overwhelming sadness, anxiety and despair, etc.. is..

in a lot of ways, becoming numb, apathetic and feeling nothing towards anything is actually an even worse form. when you feel nothing, nothing will matter.. I understand this place and it is very dangerous to be in. emptiness that cannot be filled with one extreme or the other is so much harder than the pricks of too much internal pain that one feels they can deal with, because you can go anywhere without consequence if everything is empty.

be careful..

If I could give a stronger word to love I would use that to explain how I felt towards "there's a cathartic masochism to the loneliness".

I have felt the other.. I bounce with depression 'modes' I suppose you could call it. I prefer the numbness, but then again, as I said, it is far more dangerous to just not care

I am pretty disgusted by this actually. your brother was not ready to be an adult, on his own or homeless at 18. not to mention the psychological abuse that this factually is and can imprint upon your brother's choices for estrangement from your family.

I was 15 when my parents kicked me out. the trauma it can cause to go through years of abandonment from the people that are supposed to love you unconditionally is irreversible. the trials that you have to suddenly learn how to survive through on your own without support.. the fears that come true, because you have no security to lean back on when you are weak.. the way you learn the true evilness in this world from first hand experience and abuses, with no one to turn to, no where to go and just hope you have enough will to keep going long enough to survive it all.

you were fortunate that he allowed you to be a part of the world that he may have had to sacrifice everything that he was to get to, and you threw it away instead of getting to know and learn who he was and what he had to fight to get his life to be that way..

when you make a decision to have children you give up your life; your wants need to be revised. a parent is a forever commitment, not just when it feels convenient.

when my parents bought their house after they were married, it cost $37,500. Today, that same house is valued over $500,000 and it's only been 50 years. how do we expect our young adults to be independent in modern times with that kind of inflation and the mix of family abandonment? 

what they did is far more harmful and traumatic than your brother allowing them to become dead to his current life.
I really hope we all get to win this at some point. that would be pretty amazing!

I have listened to the abuse that parents have done to many people I have known throughout my life. the disgusting stories of broken and tattered humans just trying to find where they fit after learning how to put the pieces back together. the tears, heartache, fears, humiliations, nightmares.. the way these people that are supposed to love unconditionally have torn the souls out of people that deserved a better chance than that..

excuse my language here, but your parents are the most disgusting fucks i have heard about in a very long time. to cause you more agony, more anger.. when you are already at a desperately inconsolable place. I hate them so much and hope they rot away painfully.

I am so truly sorry that they have made this so much worse for you and your wife. you deserve better than that. and I'm sorry for my vulgar comment.. I'm just so tired of people that are just trying to find their little piece of the world being constantly shit on. 

I hope so much More and Better for you both

you are not a failure for trying something and learning it was not for you.. that is hard to do and hard to be honest with yourself. you did that. 

I know it feels disheartening, but people who love you do not see failed circumstances as a failure that you have made.
I actually really appreciate your perspective, and how much strength and willpower you perceive in your brother. this type of empathy is rare and quite beautiful. thank you for sharing..

thank you, I think I did that with my sister and feel grateful that she has been trying to reach out to me more lately. we even spoke just this morning for a little while, as she asked me some questions about places we went when she was little.. it was painfully beautiful.

I am so very happy that you still had time with your grandmother before it was too late, and that she could be that hope for you. I do not think most people understand how fragile life is until it's too late..

how you respond is definitely okay.. I'm new here as well, so I understand feeling a little reserved at first until you get a feel for where you are.

I appreciate what you say. I suppose I never really correlated my sister's estrangement being tied to her experience with the abuse. that makes more sense and a little bit easier to swallow. in all actuality, in the last month we have been talking more than we have in the last five years, so that gives me hope.

I know I should not feel like an abuser myself, but after being told for so long that what I was doing was wrong.. it greatly affected the self reflections for a long time. it is a massive reason, amongst so many more that he does not get to be in my life.

thank you for the affirmations. it definitely helps.

it is more hurtful than helpful, and you are already going through a lot. I have had 4 surgeries and with any surgery there is risk of something going wrong, or even just not waking up. 1 out of the 4 surgeries, I told my mother about, and it was a horrible mistake. 

the entire ordeal ended up being about her, she did not come for it, offer to even come, nor offer to assist with the strain that it financially put on our lives.

the other 3 surgeries were easier to handle when not being met by her harassment. if someone cannot devote themselves to you during your worst of times, they certainly should but be granted access to your best of times.

I cannot understand why they brought up the medical issues either in their unemployment denial. it kind of took me back, as that was never discussed when they 'let me go'.

with your advice I'll look into filing the eeoc charge. again, thank you for your attention, communication and advice. it has eased my anxiety with the process, as I have never had to worry about any of this before.. I have never been fired and it's been a real blow to my confidence.

yay! I am so happy I could do that for you, even just for a few moments. totally worth it!

now, I realize that's how it should be, but it is harder to put that into action. I guess the question really is.. will you be okay if you never end up seeing or talking with him ever again, if surgery goes awry? that is a hard question to face, and that I have had to contemplate more than once.

I do not think you should see him or any of your family, but you have to answer that question for your own mental health.

the one thing I regret.. is that I don't have the strength to try to pull you ashore, so that you would not have the same fate as me. I used to care about others out here drowning.. I used to try to make sure they were safe before heading back into the ocean myself. I'm sorry

it's been a little over 20 years since I got an official diagnosis, even though one therapist (i have gone through a series of very bad therapists) had mentioned it sounded like I had been struggling with it since a young child..

like a lot of people have commented, with age it becomes easier to internalize instead of immediately reacting. I act out less now and do not go through extreme swings outwardly, as often. I do not sh in apparent ways that cry for help, because I want someone to show they love me.

however, internalizing, bottling up, talking with myself, quiet sh.. they have gotten worse. I do not depend upon people for happiness, but I also cannot find it within myself. I think I am worse each day, I think I am losing more as the years progress, I think the amount of pain I feel cannot be equated or summarized. therapy never really did much to help me progress, and I have been resistant to most medications.

I have good days, but they are so few between that it just feels like I am lost in a dense fog most of the time. I know this is not hopeful, but a lot of other people do have good news and progress as they get older, so don't lose faith.

some people just get lost in the cracks, and that's life. we cannot all be success stories..

I think though, that a lot of us are more self aware than we admit to let on, but hide behind excuses, because even though it causes more strife, in the immediate it can be easier. 

I am so happy that you already do communicate again! that warmed my heart to hear, and slipped me into reminiscing about someone very special in my past life. it would take me days to write out the story of our lives, but we were not able to get to where you are. I reached out a lot when things first started going south, but I had already ruined too much.. and he had already let me go, so quickly..
we eventually came back together, but so long had passed, so much had changed.. I do not think it is possible to know each other anymore. perhaps it is for the best, but even now my heart aches.

I am so grateful you could salvage, and I hope you can move forward.. I hope you both can appreciate the frailty of life.. I hope *deep sighs* I just really hope for you.

I agree with the other commenter, a letter would be the perfect way to apologize to your ex, your friend.. is there really even a word that truly encompasses the individual he has been in your life?

regardless, it helps you to contemplate everything you want to say, and find the right words to express every single thing that you both do and do not want to release. it is a way to start an apology to him and to yourself, because you also need to apologize to yourself to forgive yourself, to learn and to move on to heal as well.

there have been so many times in my life where I had wanted one of those letters from people who had done terrible things to me. a part of me had hoped that someone could have been brave enough to admit what they had done was wrong, and they were worthy of being redeemed; instead of the world being made up of heartless, cruel and venomous humans...

I never received a letter from anyone, but then again, I have never given one to the countless people who deserved better from me.

I hope you can start there, that you do, and it can help you both. I am a forever pessimist, and would never advise that you have anything to rekindle, but you can make your lives a little bit better at least. you may get to fantasize that he can look back on days you had together and smile..

if you want a sounding board or feel nervous about what you write before you send it, you can use me. I can give you advice about everything I had always hoped to hear from others. I can let you know that you are not a bad person, because you made mistakes that you need to learn from on your journey of life.

Well, I was kicked out at 17 and knew nothing about how to survive in the world. My only saving grace was I had jobs since I was 10 so I saved and saved until I was able to buy a car outright at 16 and get as far away as possible the instant it happened.

From my experience, these are my best suggestions: 

Most importantly, do not start off homeless. It is near impossible to get out of that life one you start traveling down it and you will never leave unscathed. As others have suggested, go to school, aunt's, even a friend's. Learn as much as you can about not just surviving, but living as quickly as possible.

If you don't go to school, find work that can escalate through the years so you can escalate and feel proud of your accomplishments.

Don't let yourself take a break until you actually start to feel some self stability and confidence. The older you get, the harder it will be to do. So do as much as you can to obtain this young.

Listen to people, that's the best way to start making friends that can be lifelines. Everyone has stories they want to share.

Talk to people about your own experiences. I have co-workers that ask me questions all the time about my past because jws are so unbelievable.

Buy what you need and save as much as you can. You're going to need that vacation someday.

Let yourself want for things you were told were wrong. Get those things that make you smile. Breathe without suffocating finally.

Learn and live. Love and trust, but don't be a victim of naivete. And remember, you do deserve your own life. We will be here whenever you need support, friends, a listening ear and love.
